title: VaultCreationReceipt
description: Binds a storage-configuration claim to a physical endpoint, an exact share, and a timestamped raw read-back. Written because two lanes once formed incompatible beliefs about one supposed share without either lane stating anything it believed to be false: the receipt format simply did not carry enough identity to tell the beliefs apart. A receipt saying 'WORM vault verified' is insufficient and is refused by this schema.

endpointIdentity.description: WHICH MACHINE. Without this, a claim cannot be distinguished from the same claim about a different NAS.

serial.description: Masked is acceptable; absent must be explicit null, never omitted.

volumeId.description: Catches a different volume on the same NAS.

shareIdentity.description: WHICH SHARE. exactName is what distinguishes a production vault from a disposable proof share such as CG-WORM-ENT-PROOF1.

exactName.description: Verbatim. No normalization, no aliasing -- normalization is itself a documented misattribution hypothesis.

internalShareId.description: DSM uuid where available. Survives a rename; a name alone does not.

configurationHash.description: Makes 'known-good state' comparable rather than narrative.

wormReadback.description: The configuration as READ BACK from the live device -- never the configuration that was requested. Recording intent as if it were observation is a named defect class (RECEIPT_DEFECT).

readbackTimestamp.description: Catches a share that existed at proof time and was later removed.

rawResponsePath.description: Where the preserved raw API response lives. Never inside a Git repository.

api.description: Exact API and method that produced the read-back.

secondReadback.description: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT read-back taken immediately after the first. One read-back proves what a single call returned; two agreeing read-backs distinguish a real configuration from a transient or cached response, which is the failure this schema exists to catch.

agreesWithFirst.description: MUST be true for verdict VAULT_CREATION_VERIFIED.

verdict.description: VERIFIED requires complete endpointIdentity, exact shareIdentity, live wormReadback, both proofBindings, and secondReadback.agreesWithFirst === true.
